en.title: Capture desktop screenshots
en.description: Capture a screen, app window, or region using platform-specific helpers.
tasks: Capture a screen, app window, or region using platform-specific helpers.
prerequisites: Python and OS screenshot tools; screen-recording permission on macOS.
en.example: Use screenshot. Capture only this application window and save a PNG to the folder I specify.
en.expectedResult: A screenshot file with the intended window or region captured.
limitations: Desktop permissions and supported tools differ across operating systems.

zh.title: 截取桌面画面
zh.description: 通过平台专用工具截取屏幕、应用窗口或指定区域。
tasks: 通过平台专用工具截取屏幕、应用窗口或指定区域。
prerequisites: Python 与操作系统截图工具；macOS 需要录屏权限。
zh.example: 请使用 screenshot：只截取这个应用窗口，把 PNG 保存到我指定的文件夹。
zh.expectedResult: 覆盖指定窗口或区域的截图文件。
limitations: 不同操作系统的桌面权限和可用工具不同。
